question: Which Windows OS tool is used to change the system date and time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Control Panel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Control Panel** in Windows OS is a centralized interface for managing system settings and configurations, including date and time changes.
 
• To change the system date and time, users can navigate to **Control Panel > Date and Time > Change Date and Time**.
 
• The **Date and Time settings** allow users to adjust the system clock, time zone, and synchronization settings with internet time servers.
 
• Control Panel has been a core feature in Windows OS since its early versions, providing access to hardware, software, and user account management tools.
 
• In newer Windows versions (e.g., Windows 10/11), date and time settings can also be accessed through the **Settings app**, but Control Panel remains a legacy tool for advanced configurations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Device Manager**:

 
 
• This tool is used to manage hardware devices connected to the system.
 
• It allows users to update drivers, disable/enable devices, and troubleshoot hardware issues.
 
 
 
• **File Explorer**:
 
 
• A file management tool used to browse, organize, and manage files and folders on the system.
 
• It does not provide access to system settings like date and time.
 
 
 
• **Task Manager**:
 
 
• Primarily used for monitoring system performance, managing running processes, and controlling startup programs.
 
• It does not offer options to modify system settings like date and time.
 
 
 
• **Settings App**:
 
 
• Introduced in Windows 8 and improved in Windows 10/11, it provides a modern interface for managing system configurations.
 
• It includes a section for Date and Time settings, offering a streamlined alternative to the legacy Control Panel.
